g.text: LongDS: state reuse, accuracy and cost
Six selected v1 sessions · gpt-5.6-luna · gpt-5.2 judge · first pass is primary
Bars = first pass; ○ = recovery 1; ◇ = recovery 2 (only complete trials shown). No best-of selection.
Uniform 1-hour wall limit introduced during the exploratory first pass; unreached turns are failures.
Model costs use recorded cache-aware rates; judging and infrastructure are excluded from these bars.
